During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], an '''Imperial governor''' was appointed to govern the [[Suarbi system/Legends|Suarbi system]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], he was killed and replaced by the rogue Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Leonia Tavira]] when he rebuffed her advances.
